plugins.name: somewhat-useful-claude-skills
plugins.description: A personal collection of Claude Code skills for indie game development: Godot 4 in-game UI (static and animated), itch.io store pages and devlogs, Kenney asset kit conventions, modelling new 3D assets in Blender through the MCP, a seeded method for generating games out of keyboard mash, and a feedback loop that files each skill's own defects back as a GitHub issue.
